method: Claude Code development-time research: curl of 5 public notion.com pages; excerpts are verbatim from page meta descriptions/headings and were string-checked against the fetched HTML.
limitations: Company/context research only. Not evidence of chatbot visibility; never used for mention or recommendation scores.
Pages may have changed since retrieval.
